name: Raisin Savings Marketplace

price.headline: Free to use
price.note: No fees to open or maintain an account. Raisin earns from partner banks.

key_facts.label: How it works
key_facts.value: One application gives you access to savings rates from dozens of partner banks

key_facts.label: FDIC coverage
key_facts.value: Up to $250,000 per partner bank; spread across multiple banks for more coverage

key_facts.label: Rates
key_facts.value: Competitive with top high-yield savings accounts; rates change daily

key_facts.label: Access
key_facts.value: Funds transfer to a linked external bank account; typically 1-3 business days

pros: Access to rates from many banks through one account
Can spread deposits across multiple banks for expanded FDIC coverage
cons: Not a bank itself; transfers take a few days
Rates change frequently and vary by product
best_for: people who want to compare and access high-yield rates without opening multiple bank accounts
skip_if: you need instant access to your money; transfers are not same-day
rating_reason: The marketplace model is genuinely useful for comparing rates and spreading FDIC coverage. Transfer times are the main friction point.
